scope: VS Code contributions and editor operation families
note: Completeness is inventory coverage, not runtime acceptance. Coverage references are assertions to inspect; no blanket verification claim.

operations.title: finding row/ref child
operations.result: Canonical finding focus opens or reuses the persistent DRC/ERC viewer; first opening prefers visible board source, non-preview group, inactive preview, then new split. Active preview keeps focus. Shared selection, previous/next and expanded list navigate without remounting; icon-only Copy as Markdown copies structured details. Source blur and cleared finding keep the viewer open; closing the final checks pane clears finding focus.

operations.title: Purge Reload Dev Suite (dev)
operations.preconditions: Development mode; one pcbjs source checkout; save all source edits
operations.result: Disconnect, stop checkout sessions, clean-build core/UI, clear project/model caches, package and install local extension, reload window
operations.writes: Generated build outputs, project/model caches and installed development extension; saves source edits

operations.unavailable: Hidden outside development mode; rejects missing or ambiguous source checkout
operations.missingAcceptance: Headless orchestration and transport tests; owner-window destructive end-to-end purge intentionally not run
